NTEMS data

Source: R/NTEMS.R
ntems.Rd

Get and prepare data from NTEMS (https://opendata.nfis.org/mapserver/nfis-change_eng.html):

ntemsAge(destDir, studyArea = NULL)

ntemsFires(destDir, studyArea = NULL)

ntemsHarvest(destDir, studyArea = NULL)

ntemsLeadSpp(destDir, studyArea = NULL)

ntemsWildfire(destDir, studyArea = NULL)

Arguments

destDir

character, specifying the destination directory in which to download and extract the data.

studyArea

(optional) sf polygon to which the national raster will be cropped and masked.

Value

SpatRaster

Details

  • ntemsAge(): forest age (doi:10.1016/j.rse.2023.113529 );

  • ntemsFires(): forest fires (doi:10.1080/17538947.2016.1187673 );

  • ntemsHarvest(): forest harvest disturbances (doi:10.1080/17538947.2016.1187673 );

  • ntemsLeadSpp(): leading tree species (doi:10.1016/j.rse.2022.113276 );

  • ntemsWildfire(): wildfire differenced Normalized Burn Ratio (doi:10.1016/j.rse.2014.11.005 ; doi:10.1016/j.rse.2015.09.004 ).
